stories.headline: Van Gogh's Starry Night matches a real dawn sky from 1889
stories.summary: A South Korean team found the painting's moon, Venus and Hyades star cluster line up with the sky over Saint-Rémy around July 22, 1889, a month later than its usual date.
stories.why: Experts say it's likely a blend of several nights, but it shows van Gogh watched the real sky closely.

stories.headline: A flowering shrub last collected in 1816 was found again
stories.summary: Botanists from Gauhati University surveying Assam found Ardisia colorata, a shrub first collected in India around 1816 and described in 1821, after more than 2 centuries.
stories.why: It was nearly lost to a naming mix-up: a different plant was given a similar name in 1824.

stories.stat_label: she weighs now, up from 4.4 lb
stories.headline: A man saved a 4.4 lb bear cub. Now she's 330 lb and his best friend
stories.summary: Petar Tubic found Masa abandoned in a forest in 2019 and fed her milk and fruit. She still tries to sit on his lap, and he now also cares for wolves, deer and raccoons.
stories.why: His mountain home has become a local attraction where visitors come to meet rescued animals.

stories.headline: He leapt onto a runaway school bus and stopped it
stories.summary: Ebro Ahmed, 27, saw a bus roll by with its doors open and the driver having a seizure. He jumped aboard, pulled the parking brake, then stayed with the driver until paramedics came.
stories.why: All 18 students were safe, and he says he'd rather not even take the recognition.

fun_fact: You can find the Hyades yourself: a V of stars beside the reddish star Aldebaran in Taurus.
